## Projects

Three practice web apps built with React and TypeScript. Each one runs on its own page of the site and works with the visitor's own entries or live data. None of them has a server or an account system.

### Personal Task Manager

- Page: https://abdullah-imdad-lakho.vercel.app/projects/task-manager
- What it does: add, edit and delete tasks with a title and description; mark them completed or pending; Low, Medium and High priority; due dates with overdue and due-today highlights; filter by All, Pending or Completed; search by title and sort; live totals and a progress indicator.
- Data: saved only in the visitor's browser (localStorage). No API.
- Technologies: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, the Web Storage API and an HTML dialog element.

### Expense Tracker

- Page: https://abdullah-imdad-lakho.vercel.app/projects/expense-tracker
- What it does: add, edit and delete income and expense entries with a description, a category (Food, Education, Shopping, Transport or Others) and a date; total income, total expenses and remaining balance; filter the history by type, category and date range; a monthly summary with a month picker; charts for income against expenses and spending by category.
- Data: saved only in the visitor's browser (localStorage); every total and chart is calculated from those entries. Amounts are in Pakistani rupees.
- API: optional currency conversion with live rates from Frankfurter (https://frankfurter.dev/docs/), free and with no key. If it is unavailable, the rest of the tracker keeps working.
- Technologies: React 19, TypeScript, hand-built SVG charts, the Intl API and the Web Storage API.

### Weather Dashboard

- Page: https://abdullah-imdad-lakho.vercel.app/projects/weather-dashboard
- What it does: city search that lists matching places with their country; current temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind and precipitation; condition icons for day and night; hourly temperatures for the next 24 hours; a 7-day forecast with highs, lows and chance of rain; sunrise and sunset; loading, error and no-results states.
- Data: requested live from the Open-Meteo Geocoding API (https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/geocoding-api) and Forecast API (https://open-meteo.com/en/docs), free for non-commercial use with no key. Weather data is licensed under CC BY 4.0, and place data is based on GeoNames. Only the visitor's recent city choices are remembered in the browser; no weather values are stored or estimated.
- Technologies: React 19, TypeScript, the Fetch API and SVG.
